comparison_scope: Retail structure recovered from Binary Ninja MCP (selected decompiler), radare2 CFG and angr CFGFast at the exact entry. Candidate structure recovered from the source text and from the i686-w64-mingw32-g++ -O3 object disassembly. This is a property-level comparison with an explicit CFG-shape divergence; it is not a CFG-isomorphism claim and not a behavioral-equivalence claim.

retail.bytes_sha256_scope: BN memory read and retail file .text bytes at VA 0x00514760 agree
retail.signature: std::uint32_t __cdecl Terrain_BuildMipMaps_2(TerrainMipMapsVertex r1, TerrainMipMapsVertex r2, TerrainMipMapsVertex r3, TerrainMipMapsCall* call)
retail.calling_convention: cdecl; the caller pushes the 0x14-byte call-record pointer, then copies three 0x40-byte vertex records by value below it and cleans 0xC4 bytes. The same shape is used at the five recursion sites.

return.meaning: incidental value; callers use the call record, not EAX

pseudo_callees.meaning: Binary Ninja's __builtin_memcpy for the 21 `rep movsd` 16-dword copies; radare2 does not treat them as calls

stage_regions.role: entry, g_a7e070, AND reject, near-bit dispatch

globals: 0x00A7E070 increment on entry / decrement on every return
0x00BCABD0 left x bound; 0x00BCABD4 top y bound; 0x00BCABD8 right x bound; 0x00BCABDC bottom y bound
0x00C311A0/A4/B0/B4 projection scale/offset for x and y
0x00BCAD70 depth scale; 0x00A7F894 fog scale; 0x00A7E074 fog offset; 0x005333E0 float 1.0f
retail.binary_ninja: 210 blocks, 284 edges, 2257 instructions, 7 return blocks, 26 call sites
retail.radare2: afij: size 7839, 210 blocks, 284 edges, 2257 instructions, cdecl, recursive, cc 88
retail.angr: CFGFast exact entry: result pass, 259 nodes, 354 edges, no unresolved jumps (call-site splits explain the extra nodes)
retail.cfg_cross_check: Binary Ninja and radare2 node/edge sets are identical; gate CFG score 1.0

loops.description: a 114-block cyclic SCC that contains the near stage plus the four-stage dispatch loop and its shared tails, and a one-block emitter loop at 0x00000819

candidate.runtime_stack_shape: the compiler passes the three 0x40-byte records by value (0x40 stride in the prologue) and the pointer separately; the two static recursive sites copy three 0x40-byte records into the outgoing argument area before calling. The net by-value ABI matches retail; the candidate does not emit the retail add esp,0xC4 sequence at those sites.

divergences.summary: The four duplicated retail screen stages are one parameterised clip_screen_plane() driven by a four-entry table/loop; the near stage and its attribute scaling are also folded into the same candidate CFG region.
divergences.retail: four separate stage regions with their own one-outside recursion sites (0x00515101, 0x005156A0, 0x00515BB0, 0x00516079) plus the near site 0x005164D3; 210 blocks, 284 edges, 4 cyclic SCCs, 7 retn sites.
divergences.candidate: one stage loop; 2 static self-recursion sites (0x00000FD3 near, 0x00001C3A screen); 260 blocks, 352 edges, 2 cyclic SCCs, 1 ret site.
divergences.impact: The stage order and per-stage parameters are reproduced, but a CFG-score or block-count comparison against retail is not meaningful and is not claimed. Runtime call order for the four stages is the same: left, top, right, bottom, with the same recursion arguments.
divergences.resolution: Recorded as a structural difference, not a semantic one. The property comparison above is the structural evidence; the candidate is explicitly not CFG-isomorphic.

divergences.summary: The candidate emits helper and libm calls that retail inlines: four recompute_outcode calls, four llrintl calls, and two calls to the noreturn abort helper.
divergences.retail: no external callee; outcode recomputation, FISTP and the fatal paths are inline.
divergences.candidate: 12 call instructions: 4 recompute_outcode, 4 llrintl, 2 self-recursion, 2 unresolved_state.
divergences.impact: Extra call/return and, for llrintl, a library rounding implementation instead of an inline FISTP.
divergences.resolution: Documented; no external state is touched by the helpers.

divergences.summary: clip_near_plane() and clip_screen_plane() call [[noreturn]] unresolved_state() and abort when all three vertices carry the stage bit.
divergences.retail: has no such branch. For the near stage the entry AND test makes all-three impossible; for a screen stage retail's count computation would take the count==3 value into the one-outside path and scan for an 'inside' vertex that does not exist.
divergences.candidate: aborts with a diagnostic instead of executing that retail path.
divergences.impact: A count==3 screen stage is not proved unreachable from this function alone. If it is reachable, the candidate terminates where retail would continue with out-of-range role assignment.
divergences.resolution: Left as a documented, deliberate trap. This is the main reason the status is STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED and not a behavioral claim.

divergences.summary: The purpose of g_a7e070 (0x00A7E070) is not established.
divergences.retail: incremented on entry and decremented on every return path; no other access in this function.
divergences.candidate: the same increment/decrement pair, with no invented meaning.
divergences.impact: If the counter has a semantic consumer elsewhere, only the pair is reproduced here.
divergences.resolution: Documented; the name is not asserted.

divergences.summary: Retail converts the packed colour/alpha with FISTP under the caller's inherited x87 control word; the candidate calls llrintl.
divergences.retail: FISTP qword at 0x00516592, 0x005165A7, 0x005165B9, 0x005165CD; no FLDCW in the function.
divergences.candidate: llrintl per the C contract rounds according to the current rounding mode, but the MinGW libm implementation and its use of the inherited x87/MXCSR state were not inspected.
divergences.impact: A non-default inherited rounding mode could change the packed colour/alpha by one.
divergences.resolution: Not proved either way; recorded as a limitation.

divergences.summary: Record bytes +0x21..+0x23 are never read by this function.
divergences.retail: the caller's by-value copies leave the three padding bytes as stack garbage; the emitter copies 0x20 bytes including them.
divergences.candidate: the same three bytes are carried through the record and copied; terrain_draw.cpp's caller-side zero-initialisation is documented separately.
divergences.impact: Output bytes +0x21..+0x23 can differ from retail because the caller initialises them differently; this function itself is faithful.
divergences.resolution: Recorded; caller-side difference, not a divergence in this unit.

divergences.summary: Record +0x24 is a pointer into this function's frame and dangles after return.
divergences.retail: writes the clip scratch pointer into each record; the caller's by-value copies retain the dangling value.
divergences.impact: No read after return in either implementation.

divergences.summary: The noreturn abort helper registers an SJLJ unwind frame; the main function does not.
divergences.candidate: unresolved_state() references _Unwind_SjLj_Register and __gxx_personality_sj0; the main function has no unwind registration.
divergences.impact: Only the trap path is affected.

divergences.summary: The catalog name Terrain_BuildMipMaps_2 implies mip-chain construction, but the body has no level loop, allocation or texture access.
divergences.candidate: retains the established symbol for the VA and documents the contradiction.

limitations: The candidate is not CFG-isomorphic: 260 blocks / 352 edges / 2 cyclic SCCs vs retail 210 / 284 / 4, because the four retail screen stages are factored into one table-driven loop.
No runtime, Frida/IGI-Probe, paired-game or rendered-output evidence exists for this function; RUNTIME_TESTED and VERIFIED are not claimed.
The screen-stage count==3 abort path is not proved unreachable, so the candidate may terminate where retail would continue.
llrintl's rounding-mode behaviour was not verified against the inherited x87 control word.
The purpose of g_a7e070 is unknown; only its increment/decrement pair is reproduced.
The +0x21..+0x23 padding bytes depend on the caller's initialisation and can differ.

The linked candidate build-clean-win32/igi1.exe (sha256 35d92a3a...) contains the pre-fix transcription (receipt source b90d5eaa..., TU object 63e864d5..., symbol at 0x00460C50), not the corrected source 7e3c712a... / object caac5725.... The corrected object was compiled standalone and was not relinked or run here.
The object leaves 13 retail globals undefined by design; this report does not prove the link-time definitions are correct.

status_recommendation.rationale: The retail function was recovered at the exact entry with Binary Ninja, radare2 and angr; the BN and radare2 node/edge sets are identical (score 1.0). The candidate reproduces the entry gate, stage order and masks, per-intersection rounding, one-outside recursion, outcode recomputation, emitter and g_a7e070 side effects at source and object level. The comparison is property-level and explicitly not CFG-isomorphic.
remaining: Screen-stage count==3 abort is a deliberate divergence.
x87 control-word inheritance at the FISTP replacements is unresolved.
status_recommendation.gate_projection: With the manifest record rebound to this source, the structural checks (binary hash, address, implementation path/hash, BN/r2/angr evidence, semantic review) can pass at --threshold STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED. The strict default also requires a live behavioral_runner, which this record does not have; that check must remain a blocker.
